rule: A form is listed only if the real TypeScript parser produces its key from the canonical phrase (textForm) or the engine evaluates the key when it is constructed directly (typedOnly), and the evidence matcher returns a verdict on a manufacturer sentence. verify-contract.mts checks every example.
numbers: Digits only ("4", not "four"). A spelled number never reaches a numeric form.

forms.evidence: registered manufacturer states it for the exact product

probe.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 has a steel tray, which is dishwasher safe.
The Acme Tilo 3 is not wireless.

forms.evidence: all words in one clause in order (at most 3 words apart, stems for long words); any negation, 'only', 'adapter', 'requires' in that predicate = unverified; performance words (quiet, easy, durable, ...) need two independent expert groups
forms.caution: write the attribute words only; never the product noun or the person ('for left-handed users' keeps 'users')

probe.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 frame is powder-coated and is rust-proof.
The Acme Tilo 3 has no rain hood.

forms.evidence: a stated value of the same unit decides (value >= N); an optional noun must be within 40 characters of the value

probe.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 seats up to 8 guests.

forms.evidence: every stated value of the unit is compared; a second figure for another quantity (a load limit) in the same clause can decide it

probes.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 holds loads up to 20 lb (9 kg).
probes.meaning: engine gap: the load figure decides the product-weight requirement

forms.evidence: the anchor word must stand within 40 characters of the value: separates the product's own weight from a load limit
forms.note: no request phrase makes the TypeScript parser emit this key ('weighs at most 7 kg' -> at-most-7-kg); only a typed adapter can build it

probes.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 holds loads up to 20 lb (9 kg).
probes.meaning: a load figure is not the product weight

forms.note: the parser emits the anchor only when the noun directly follows the unit; 'lifts at least 40 lb of gravel' splits into at-least-40-lb + lifts + gravel

probe.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 lifts up to 50 lb of gravel.

forms.evidence: only a bounded statement ('up to N', 'N to M', 'maximum N') of the same dimension decides; unit must be in unitDimensions

probe.sentence: The Acme Tilo 3 holds dogs up to 60 lb (27 kg).
The Acme Tilo 3 serves 4 to 5 people.
The Acme Tilo 3 fits two people.

forms.note: the parser makes 'for my <person>' context; 'for the <place>' stays a MUST proposition ('for the garden' -> unrecognized:for-the-garden). No text form loosens a place.

forms.textForm: griddle plate for the Velka VK-5
forms.hazard: '<Brand> <Part Noun> for the <Brand> <Host>' locks the HOST as a STANDALONE product (observed: prepared the host). Write '<part noun> for the <Brand> <Host>'.
forms.evidence: fit verb followed by the exact host model; a list after a colon, or a sentence with 'only', is not credited (engine gap)

forms.note: brand in the Latin script the catalog uses; a Hangul brand ('벨카') does not resolve

forms.textForm: Brannor Emberlo 24 Stove with Kettle Bundle
Acme Tilo 3, at least $300 and at most $400
forms.note: money is outside the interpreter contract: only the parser sets it; 'between $300 and $400' is misread, an amount in words is never applied (policy)

unsupported.why: no 'down to' / minimum-rating direction; WITHIN accepts only upper bounds and ranges
the engine needs the literal word 'across'; 'diameter', 'bowl' are not its synonyms; dropping the word weakens the dimension

unsupported.example: 'insect screen' vs 'bug screen'; 'reversible' vs 'has a reverse switch'
unsupported.why: propositions match words literally; no alternative list
an evidence must-not needs a page that states the absence; there is no title/variant exclusion for discovery
no text form; satisfied only by the exact lock itself (a typed adapter can drop the must-not when the lock is exact)
fail-closed: the manufacturer sentence 'burns <fuel> only; it does not run on <other>' carries 'only' and a negation
'=' on a load is not a threshold; kept verbatim, fail-closed
